reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation class: issue is the absence of WITH CHECK, not an unreachable function). Gate 2: attack vector is the authenticated Supabase REST API — no trust_assumptions entry exists and the caller is an untrusted end-user. Gate 3: supabase/migrations/ is explicitly in scope. The security fix migration 20260317000001 adds FORCE RLS and revokes anon access but does NOT patch the UPDATE policy; L83 of 0000_create_member_schema.sql still reads `USING (auth.uid() = id)` with no WITH CHECK clause, leaving is_admin, status, and generation unrestricted. An attacker can trigger this via the Supabase REST API by sending PATCH /rest/v1/members?id=eq.<their-uuid> with body {"is_admin": true} using their own JWT, causing full admin privilege escalation system-wide including OAuth application management.
